requirements.text: Ensure all new features comply with PSD2, GDPR, and Central Bank regulations to minimize compliance risk.
Implement real-time notifications for account transactions, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations.
Allow customers to manage their cards through the app in a compliant manner.
Maintain a seamless integration with the existing core banking system while preserving compliance integrity.
Conduct thorough regulatory reviews before launching any features to avoid exposure to enforcement actions.
